description: Search company pages by keywords and filters, read FRESH at request time. Returns the first 1,000 results per query; page with `start`. Costs $0.0012 per live read. Give `keywords` or at least one filter. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

filters.description: Named filters, each a list: industry (numeric industry ids), size (headcount bands), location (numeric place ids).

start.description: Zero-based offset into the first 1,000 results.

name: page_search
title: Search Company Pages
